findings.current: We were watching over the world, and you shone on your own within it. Bright enough to see clearly, even from far away.
findings.defect: “Watching over” suggests guardianship; the speaker says they were looking down upon the world.
findings.rationale: 굽어보고 있었고 describes their vantage over the world, not a protective role.
findings.replacement: We were looking down upon the world, and you shone on your own within it. Bright enough to see clearly, even from far away.
findings.source: 우리는 천하를 굽어보고 있었고, 당신은 그 안에서 스스로 빛났던 거죠. 멀리서도 또렷하게 알아볼 수 있을 만큼.

findings.current: He’d told him to find one person whose appearance and whereabouts were unknown.
findings.defect: The unknowns are when and where the person would appear, not what the person looked like.
findings.rationale: 언제, 어디에서 나타날지 specifies the time and place of an eventual appearance.
findings.replacement: He’d told him to find someone who might appear at any time, in any place.
findings.source: 도대체 언제, 어디에서 나타날지 모를 한 사람을 찾으라고.

findings.current: Only three letters remained in his empty head.
findings.defect: “Level Up” is not three English letters.
findings.rationale: 세 글자 counts the three Korean syllable blocks in 레벨 업; the English letter count does not carry over.
findings.replacement: Only one phrase remained in his empty head.
findings.source: 텅 비어 버린 뇌리에 유일하게 남아 있는 세 글자도 함께.

findings.current:
A sharp gleam flashed behind her veil. Thick vines crept up my body and tightened around my neck.

Slowly. And with steadily increasing force.
findings.defect: The source has one thick stem, and its grip is slow and strong simultaneously; it does not say the force steadily increases.
findings.rationale: 줄기가 is singular, and 천천히. 동시에 강하게. pairs the speed and strength of the tightening.
findings.replacement:
A sharp gleam flashed behind her veil. A thick vine crept up my body and tightened around my neck.

Slowly. And powerfully.
findings.source:
몸뚱어리를 타고 스멀스멀 기어오른 두꺼운 줄기가 내 목을 옥죄었다.

천천히. 동시에 강하게.

findings.current: She’d read the sincerity in my breathless voice—in the eyes that, unlike hers, were sunk deep and steady.
findings.defect: “Unlike hers” makes the contrast with the Grand Mage’s eyes. The source contrasts his steady gaze with his breathless voice.
findings.rationale: 그와 달리 refers back to his breathless delivery, not to the woman’s gaze.
findings.replacement: She’d heard the sincerity in my breathless voice and seen it in my eyes, which were steady despite my labored breathing.
findings.source: 가쁘게 내뱉어진 내 음성에, 그와 달리 깊게 가라앉은 눈빛에 담긴 진심을 읽었기 때문이었다.

summary: Five actionable fidelity findings: an altered comparison, a changed detail in the Martial God’s letter, a protective connotation absent from the source, an invented change in the vine’s force, and an incorrect letter count.
